changes.title: Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink introduces enhanced snapshots
changes.detail: Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink now supports enhanced snapshots, a capability that lets you capture, export, and restore application state across Apache Flink applications and AWS Regions, so you can run blue/green deployments, easily migrate self-managed workloads to Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink without losing state, and keep backup in a secondary Region for cross-Region recovery. changes.title: Amazon RDS for SQL Server now supports M8id and R8id instances
changes.detail: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for SQL Server now supports M8id and R8id instances. These instances are powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors, available only on AWS, and include local NVMe SSD storage. They scale up to 384 vCPUs, 3 TiB of memory, and 22.8 TB of local NVMe SSD storage. That's 4x the vCPUs and memory and more than 6x the local storage of M5d and R5d instances. When you create or modify a DB instance to use M8id or R8id, RDS for SQL Server automatically places the tempdb data and log files on the local NVMe instance store.
